audit.why: Level chart already has Tristana favoured levels 1-5, even at 6, and flipping late (2+ items) to the item-scaled Aphelios (Infernum/Crescendum) — matches the kit: Trist out-ranges his clunky early guns, he out-scales once his gun rotation completes.

Spikes correctly flag level 2 all-in start, the even level-6 window against Moonlight Vigil, and the first-item burst spike; breakdown.cooldowns was missing the actual Moonlight Vigil cooldown number, which is a lint-catchable defect (rule 3: cooldowns field must contain a number).
audit.corrected: Added 120/110/100s for Moonlight Vigil (R) and 14s (rank 5) for Rocket Jump.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED) instead of explaining the named mechanic.
audit.why: dosFull[1].d's title is 'Commit at four stacks or back at three' but its body was the tradeGood sentence; dontsFull[2].d's title is 'Hold R as only an execute' but its body was the tradeBad sentence about jumping in unstacked, which is a different mistake.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dosFull[1].d to restate the stack-detonation threshold in its own words, and dontsFull[2].d to explain Buster Shot's actual value (peel/setup, not just execute) — matching each title.

edits.before: E the bomb, stack two autos, and step back at three — the threat does the zoning and the fourth stack stays loaded.
edits.after: Four stacks means the bomb detonates — commit only once loaded, or hold at three and let the threat alone zone him off farm.

edits.before: Jumping in with the bomb unstacked and R down — Tristana without the string is a yordle tourist at a gunfight.
edits.after: Buster Shot only executes low HP — its real value is peeling a diver or setting up the jump-bomb string before he closes.

edits.before: - Aphelios Moonlight Vigil: matchup-defining — The teamfight opener whose damage depends on his loaded gun — never clump once he hits 6. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Rocket Jump (reset) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Aphelios Moonlight Vigil (R): 120/110/100s cooldown — the teamfight opener whose damage depends on his loaded gun; never clump once he hits 6, and step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Rocket Jump (14s at 5) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.

notes: Rest of the ten breakdown.* fields (early/mid/wave/trading/spikes/feeding/carry/difficulty/late), ahead, tradeGood, tradeBad, loading and enemyWin already name Aphelios-specific mechanics (Moonlight Vigil, Explosive Charge stacks, Rocket Jump resets, Infernum/Crescendum scaling) rather than reading as swap-the-name templates, so left as-is. suspectNames was empty and no fabricated ability names found — Weapon Abilites/Weapon Queue System/Phase in the brief are just the packet's generic slot labels, not names used anywhere in currentText.
